Bihar MLC Election Result: bihar ke Darbhanga men MLC chunav ki matganna ke dauran hangame ki khabar samne aaee hai. jankari ke mutabik, matganna kendr par jansuraj aur kangres pratyashiyon ke samarthakon ke bich vivad ho gaya. sthiti ke bad pulis ne donon pakshon ke karyakartaon ko hirasat men liya.
Matganna kendr par hue vivad aur pulis ki karravaee se juri puri jankari ke lie vidiyo dekhen.
